description: Use this when the user wants to convert a GEDCOM file to Excel or a spreadsheet, list everyone in their family tree file, or check a GEDCOM (.ged) file for errors ("open my gedcom in excel", "find mistakes in my family tree file"). Pass the attachment as file or pasted text as gedcom_text. Returns an Excel workbook with one row per individual (names, birth and death dates and places, parents, spouse families), one row per family, and a Checks sheet listing broken links, impossible dates, people born after they died or older than 120, parents born after their children or under 12, and people recorded as their own ancestor. Does not change or fix the GEDCOM file, research records, or draw a chart (use generate_pedigree_chart for the chart).

file.description: The GEDCOM file (.ged) exported from a genealogy program or website, e.g. family.ged. A .zip that contains one .ged file also works.

download_url.description: Temporary download link for the file, supplied by ChatGPT.

file_name.description: Original file name if known, e.g. statement.pdf.

mime_type.description: Media type if known, e.g. application/pdf.

gedcom_text.description: Fallback only: GEDCOM text pasted into the chat, starting with lines like "0 HEAD" and "0 @I1@ INDI". Prefer file when the user attached a .ged file.

name: convert_gedcom_to_excel
title: Convert GEDCOM to Excel
